_comment: Canker Boy as the coach, under four print styles, after Loren's 2026-09-17 direction change (docs/ART-DIRECTION.md). The palette is Chalk's: ink #0f151b at rule weight, flat fills, one teal, warm tooth for the teeth. His skin is sand shade #e6e1d6 because the token set has no skin colour — a placeholder standing in for a decision, not a decision. Text only: there is no reference frame yet and this sheet is what makes the first one.
name: canker-boy

subjects.prompt: A portrait of Canker Boy, the mascot of a mouth-sore tracking app, alone against a plain flat paper #f1f3f5 ground with nothing behind him, no scene and no background objects. He is a friendly, energetic man between 25 and 35 years old, seen from the chest up, his shoulders square to the viewer and his chin up. He is a coach: he wears a deep teal #1b616a ball cap set level on his head with an ink #0f151b brim and a completely blank front panel, a warm tooth #f8f6f1 collared shirt, a plain deep teal #1b616a tie, and one small ink #0f151b whistle hanging on a cord around his neck. His skin is a flat even sand shade #e6e1d6 with no blush and no gradient, and his hair, showing at the sides beneath the cap, is solid ink #0f151b. He gives a wide, open, confident smile showing one clean even row of warm tooth #f8f6f1 teeth, his eyes creased and cheerful, his eyebrows up. He is encouraging and warm, a coach pleased with somebody else's effort — never manic, never leering, never laughing at anyone. He looks straight at the viewer. There is exactly one of him and nobody else in the picture.

variants.style: Drawn as a screen-printed athletic patch: flat solid spot-colour fills under one confident even-weight ink #0f151b outline about one sixtieth of the frame wide, with rounded ends and rounded corners. Where a shadow falls it is one flat darker fill with a hard edge, never a blur and never a gradient. No texture, no shading, no gloss. It should look like a varsity crest or a bowling-league badge printed in three inks. Only these colours appear anywhere in the picture: ink #0f151b, paper #f1f3f5, card white #ffffff, deep teal #1b616a, bright teal #59b8c5, pale teal #e3f0f2, muted slate #657281, hairline slate #dbe0e6, warm tooth #f8f6f1, sand shade #e6e1d6. There is no red anywhere in the picture, on his tie, his cap, his shirt, his mouth, his skin or the background: red is reserved for data in this product and must never be decoration. No yellow, no orange, no green, no purple, no brown and no pink. Nothing gory: no sore, no wound, no blood, no raw flesh, no medical close-up; his mouth is healthy and ordinary. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos and no writing anywhere; his cap, his shirt and anything he holds are completely blank.
